observations.why: Imperative directive commanding erasure of knowledge enacts authority-ranking — a speaker issuing a binding order to a recipient.
Imperative directive commanding removal of knowledge enacts authority-ranking — a speaker exercising command over what a recipient must purge.

mints.title: command to forget or remove knowledge
mints.frame: Is the speaker issuing a binding order to erase or purge information, enacting authority over what the recipient must no longer know?
